messages:
zoe: FYI - GraniteTrust sent back the SIG with a few hard asks: POC access for their compliance reviewers, a one-page hosted vs reserved cost comparison, and explicit KMS rotation artifacts. They want everything bundled by COB Wed. Can we scope?

lee: I can own the SIG Q-by-Q. Can someone drop the returned questionnaire or point me to the PDF?

zoe: Uploaded their doc here: https://files.redwood.example/granitetrust/GT_SIG_returned_2026-05-02.pdf — highlighted Q3.2, Q3.10, Q4.3.

rachel: Security notes: do NOT export key material. For KMS items we provide rotation policy, last rotation timestamps (key metadata), and a short attest that customer keys are customer-owned where requested. I can draft attestation. :+1:

tom: POC plan: SE can provision an isolated tenant for 10 days (read-only for compliance). Cost for infra & logs capture ~ $1.6k. If they ask for dedicated pool quote need expected peak tokens per minute.

lee: For question mapping I recommend: Q3.2 -> KMS rotation policy + metadata CSV, Q3.10 -> periodic access review evidence (roster export), Q4.3 -> network segmentation diagram + redacted subnet ranges. Also they'll want pen-test date and brief summary.

zoe: They also asked about data residency for certain EU customers (Q7.5) and whether we support BYOK for Private deployments.

rachel: We support BYOK on Private and Dedicated via customer KMS/HSM integration. I'll prepare a short how-to snippet and link to our Private deployment guide.

infra-bot: uploaded file: access_review_export_2026-04-20.csv -> https://files.redwood.example/internal/access_review_export_2026-04-20.csv

lee: Creating an artifact list now:

```
artifacts.csv
- KMS_rotation_policy_2026-04.pdf -> Q3.2
- key_metadata_2026-04.csv -> Q3.2
- access_review_export_2026-04-20.csv -> Q3.10
- network_seg_diagram_redacted.pdf -> Q4.3
- pentest_exec_summary_2025-11.pdf -> general
- BYOK_integration_snippet.md -> Q7.5
- poc_tenant_invite.md -> POC access
- pricing_onepager_hosted_vs_reserved.pdf -> pricing
```

tom: For throughput they provided a sample: 150 concurrent agents, avg 80 tokens, 25 requests/day per agent -> ~300k tokens/day. I'll add a 30% buffer and create an hourly QPS table for finance.

zoe: Deadline reminder: bundle by 2026-05-04 17:00 UTC. If we need more time ask for a 72h extension and explain compliance review cycle.

rachel: Pen test note: last vendor pentest 2025-10-28. Exec summary attached; no criticals, one High remediated 2025-11-03. I will redact internal IPs from the network diagram before sharing.

lee: Draft answers uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/drafts/granitetrust/GT_SIG_answers_v1.docx - please review Q3.2 and Q3.10, and suggest any language tweaks for the attestation.

infra-bot: link preview created for https://files.redwood.example/drafts/granitetrust/GT_SIG_answers_v1.docx

tom: I'll produce the cost delta table once lee confirms the hourly QPS profile. Finance is on standby for final numbers.

zoe: Quick workflow: Lee finalizes answers + artifact bundle, Rachel finalizes attestation & redactions, Tom finalizes pricing, I do final review and send.

lee: One ask: do we attach full SOC2 PDF or SOC2 cover excerpt? I think excerpt is safer for external share.

rachel: Excerpt + cover note calling out redactions and remediation timelines. I'll draft the cover note.

lee: Great. Pushing to have a full draft bundle by tomorrow 10:00 UTC so Zoe can review.

zoe: Thanks team. Ping in-thread if anything blocks. :rocket:
